text:
Like a black wing I spread my hair

across your knees.

Closing your eyes, you breathed its fragrance,

then asked me:

“Do you sleep on moss-covered stones?

Do you bind your braids with willow branches?

Is clover your pillow? Is your hair so black

because you pressed into it the dark,

thick juice of wild blackberries?

What a fresh, strange fragrance surrounds you!

You smell of streams, of earth and forests.

What perfume do you wear?” Laughing, I told you:

“None, none!

I love you and I am young; I smell of spring.

The scent you breathe is firm flesh,

clear cheeks, and new blood.

I love you and I am young; that is why I carry

the very fragrances of spring!”

translation.title: Like Spring
translation.editorial_note: The erotic catalog remains rooted in landscape, youth, and an unperfumed body.
